AI literacy rank test

12 questions · six dimensions · instant explanations

This 12-question test covers six dimensions: concepts, pricing, capability limits, industry landscape, practical skills and safety. Every answer gets immediate right/wrong feedback with a one-line explanation (testing as learning), the score maps to nine ranks (from Outsider to Pro 9-dan), and the result page shows a six-dimension radar plus pointers for what to study next. For fun only.

How it works

· 12 single-choice questions (including 2 true/false), one tap each, no going back
· Instant feedback and explanation after each question — wrong answers are the best time to learn
· Two questions per dimension: concepts / pricing / limits / industry / practice / safety
· Generate a rank poster at the end and challenge your friends
